title: The Virtue of Teaching the Qur'an to Children

text_simplified: The text speaks of the virtue of reciting the Noble Qur'an and the importance of teaching it to children. It mentions that whoever recites the Qur'an and acts upon it shall enter Paradise. It also indicates that teaching the Qur'an to young ones elevates their status in the Hereafter.
